brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION PROMPT
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished editorial thumbnail for Japanese basketball site バスケまとめ. Landscape 16:9, about 1600×900 pixels, PNG. It must be an unmistakable hand-drawn ink and brush sports illustration, never photographic.

ARTICLE BASIS (only these verified facts may inform the text): Fixed article dated 2026-10-31 is about best-five selections from the currently registered players of clubs scheduled to play that day, selected separately by league using season-average EFF. This is pregame information, NOT game results. Selection does not confirm participation. No player achievements, individual numbers, scores, or claims of actual performance may appear.

STYLE: Approved editorial look is dark near-black #151A18 with vivid lime #CCF43B, off-white bold Japanese type, coarse expressive ink contours, dry-brush textures and a few sweeping lime strokes, ample calm space around typography. Orange basketball accent. Match that visual language, but use a fresh reversed layout: athlete on LEFT, headline on RIGHT. Do not reproduce any old reference headline, score or named player. No photographic textures, no real photo cutouts.

SUBJECT: Exactly one real person: Kaelen Joel Allen / ケーレン ジョエル・アレン (KJ Allen). He was randomly selected from the fixed article's 30 named players, so his name, team, jersey number and personal statistics must NOT be written in the image. His identity MUST remain visually based on the verified official current portrait, not a generic invented athlete.
Observed current official portrait appearance: Black American male basketball player, age 26, very strong broad-shouldered stocky power-forward build, muscular upper arms, deep medium-brown skin; short dense black tightly curled hair, modest height on top, cropped sides (NOT braids, NOT long hair); broad oval-to-rectangular face with a strong broad jaw, slightly heavy-lidded narrow almond-shaped dark eyes, eyebrows gently angled; broad nose with softly rounded tip; full lips; thin moustache connected visually with a short dark neatly shaped goatee on the chin, lighter short beard along jaw. Distinct dark tattoos cover much of both upper arms. Capture this specific face and heavy athletic build in expressive readable off-white, warm brown and black ink planes. Keep facial features clear, not swallowed by black shadows.
Verified portrait source consulted: https://basketball.shinagawa-city.com/team/players/detail/id=60080?PlayerID=49710 and its official portrait https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026103108/files/user/roster/748/2026-27/49710_01.jpg. These are appearance references only; do not reproduce the photograph.
CLOTHING: plain off-white basketball jersey and shorts with dark trim, no number, no text, no insignia, no team or sponsor logos.
ACTION: A dynamic low dribble / powerful driving step, torso leaning diagonally forward, head turned slightly towards the center looking ahead, one hand controlling an orange basketball low beside his body, the other arm naturally bent for balance. Show face, both arms, both hands, basketball and bent thighs clearly. Torso and legs anatomically plausible; exactly two arms and two hands, natural five-digit hands, no fused fingers. Basketball fully contained inside the frame. It is a conceptual basketball illustration, NOT reconstruction of any actual game, shot or play. Do not add any other players, crowds, stadium marks, trophies or logos.

COMPOSITION: Left approximately 43% is the large active figure. Right approximately 52% is typography on a quiet black area. Keep all headline and footnote text within 5% outer margins. Athlete and ball must not obscure lettering. Use a few angled brush strokes behind the athlete. The face and basketball remain generously inset from all edges. Intentional thigh crop is acceptable; hands, face and ball must not be cut off. Make the main headline exceptionally large and legible as a small thumbnail, with the numeral 5 bold but integrated with ベスト.

EXACT VISIBLE TEXT ONLY, render every character precisely:
Small top brand: "バスケまとめ"
Date: "2026.10.31"
Small compact badge: "試合前"
Main headline, two stacked lines:
"登録選手"
"ベスト5"
Medium scope line: "本日の対戦クラブから"
Medium explanatory line: "リーグ別・今季平均EFFで独自選出"
Clearly readable qualifier below: "出場確定ではありません"
Bottom footer on uncluttered dark strip, sufficiently large: "イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ"

HIERARCHY: main headline off-white with ベスト5 in vivid lime, supporting scope/caveat text off-white; brand and date smaller. Use heavy Japanese gothic type, balanced spacing, controlled brush texture. Do not add any text besides the exact listed text. No names, no scores, no stats, no signatures, no English slogans, no league logos or official seals.

ONE ALLOWED CORRECTION PROMPT
Edit Image 1, the generated basketball thumbnail. Image 2 is the verified official portrait of the real athlete Kaelen Joel Allen and is ONLY an identity reference. Do not paste the photograph, copy its uniform, logos or lettering.

Make one targeted correction pass for athlete rendering and containment. Preserve the entire right-hand typography, all exact words, sizes, spelling, colors, overall dark #151A18 and lime #CCF43B brush/ink style, landscape 16:9 aspect ratio and resolution. There must still be exactly one player, no logos or sponsors, and no player name/number/statistics. The final asset is a hand-drawn sports illustration, not a photo.

Fix clipping: proportionally reduce the left-side player AND his held/dribbled orange ball as one coherent composition to roughly 85-88% of their current size, move them a little right and down within the LEFT portion, keeping the same dynamic low dribble pose. Ensure the whole hair/head is at least 45 pixels below the top edge, the entire ball and EVERY fingertip on the ball-side hand are at least 50 pixels INSIDE the left edge. No hand, finger, head or ball may touch or cross any edge. Maintain two arms and two anatomically coherent five-digit hands with natural ball contact; do not add limbs. The lower thigh may intentionally continue off the bottom. Do not overlap the lettering on the right.

Likeness: use the current real official portrait in Image 2 to closely guide the face. His hair is SHORT, dense tight black curls, with a low top and cropped sides, rather than the exaggerated tall irregular afro in Image 1. Match his broad oval-to-rectangular face, heavy-lidded almond-shaped eyes, broad nose, full lips, thin moustache and chin goatee, and muscular broad-shouldered solid build. Keep face readable and artistically rendered in ink. Retain arm tattoos as restrained illustrative linework rather than photographic copying.

All following text remains exactly as in Image 1:
バスケまとめ
2026.10.31
試合前
登録選手
ベスト5
本日の対戦クラブから
リーグ別・今季平均EFFで独自選出
出場確定ではありません
イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ

Do not introduce any additional words or marks. This depicts a conceptual image, never a documented moment from an actual game. Return exactly one corrected finished PNG.
